definitions.unit: listing chain (Tiingo rows of one ticker with gaps <= 5 days)
definitions.withSeries: mapped weekly series with >= 1 bar in year
definitions.frameQualified: mapped series in V10/V11 frame with >= 1 loader bar in year
definitions.ended: chains whose effective end lies in year (effective end < 2026-09-28)
definitions.endedWithSeries: ended chains with a mapped series with a bar in that year
definitions.endedWithLifecycle: ended chains whose mapped series carries an SEC-sourced last trading day (DELISTED_SOURCE_VERIFIED)
